artworks.label: Sapphire bluebell
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE entirely new original standalone square 1024 x 1024 Glaze illustration for bluewing. One gracefully arching stem carrying three delicate sapphire-blue bellflowers, a pair of narrow charcoal-blue leaves and two clear round dewdrops, each translucent petal showing natural fine striations, deep indigo shading and subtle cobalt iridescence. Whole botanical spray as an elegant compact silhouette. Fine-art natural macro photography, realistically delicate botanical textures, restrained grazing light and deep blue-black shadows, not a cartoon or neon. Matches the theme's rich cobalt/sky-blue butterfly scales, charcoal-blue #161E2A background, silver/sapphire accents. Distinct flower subject, no butterfly, chrysalis or detached wing. Whole subject visible, airy 18 percent clear margin all sides; readable as a small iPhone artwork widget. Truly transparent empty background, no floor, opaque tile, border or backdrop, alpha preserved. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, numbers, lettering, dates, clock hands, dials, calendars, UI, brands or watermark. Do not copy, recolour or crop an existing asset.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q92 method6; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
